text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —That is a shameful desire.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: When instincts clash against instincts, this body cannot stem the pouring sweat, left only to burn itself out amidst ragged breaths.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: There is only one victor. If you pursue it according to your desires—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
There is no escape anymore.
Only to drown in that sheer ecstasy.

Having accidentally dozed off in the library,
I ended up heading back late.
Amidst a stillness completely opposite to the daytime hustle—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, why...?
Why must you dwell in the silence...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Even though you know you'll never be satisfied.

Under a moon veiled faintly by clouds,
Still in Love was running all alone.

She looked completely enraptured, yet at the same time,
somewhat troubled and lost in thought――
choice_data_list: You're really dedicated, staying out this late.
You're really dedicated, staying out this late.

text_block_list.text:
She looked completely enraptured, yet at the same time,
somewhat troubled and lost in thought――
choice_data_list: You're really dedicated, staying out this late.
You're really dedicated, staying out this late.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... You are...
The moment I called out, her face shifted into an anxious look, completely unlike a moment ago. But as if instantly regaining her composure――

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
........
Thank you for your concern.
...However.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Just you speaking to me is more than enough.
...Please, forget about tonight.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I shall head back as well.
……Before the moon is completely hidden away.

...As if refusing any further conversation,
Still in Love stared up at the moon
without meeting my gaze.

I was treated to a truly wondrous experience,
one I don't think I'll ever forget...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: You are...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed.
...The fire within me won't cool down.
The more I run... the hotter it burns...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: , I find myself wanting it.

Still in Love smiled bewitchingly.
For a fleeting instant, a chill ran down my spine,
but before I could confirm what caused it――

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Farewell, traveler met on a hazy night.
May you never be swallowed by the dark—
Letting out a faint chuckle, Still in Love dashed off once again.

Though it had only been a fleeting moment,
it was a night that made me feel as if I were dreaming.
